'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Nicolae Borota DS Fear Is My Ally''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nicolae Borota]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
